name: Fermatix Team
subject: Non-exclusive training licence — eight private production repos (AIdeazz)
note: Fermatix inbound-source licence letter. Elena clicks ➡️ SEND BY EMAIL. Do not connect GitHub in this first email. Metadata/NDA first. Refuse exclusive/assignment. HUD listing stays private. Do not volunteer were-public.
body:
Hi Fermatix team,

I solely own eight private production repositories — live AI exec seats covering CRM/GEO, job-hunt, bilingual WhatsApp/Telegram, and an X agent. Proof: https://aideazz.xyz/portfolio

I am offering a non-exclusive training licence of copies of that source. I keep copyright, brand, domains, and every product running. No assignment. Production systems, CRM, chat logs, keys, and client material are out of scope.

Your FAQ says you source non-public repos and pay rights-holders royalties. If you inbound-source from a live solo lab (not only discontinued products), I would like to hear how you start — metadata and NDA first, not a GitHub app.

Elena Revicheva
AIdeazz AI Lab · Panama City
aipa@aideazz.xyz
https://aideazz.xyz/portfolio
